_doc: One expert per flow role. `policy` mirrors framework/tools.py policy_for(): paths are relative to the run root; {experiment} is the experiment named in the builder's instructions. shell: null | ro | rw. gpu: null | ro | run | rw. Every member also gets view_page.

leader.description: Stages a paper into a run directory and launches the paper-reproducer workflow; does no reproduction work itself.

lead.description: Reads the paper and scope, lists arms and claims, writes one runnable spec per experiment.

figure.description: Reads paper numbers that exist only in plots, from the rendered page.

figure-check.description: Second, independent reading of the same figure on the other model tier.

builder.description: Implements and runs one experiment in repo/arms/<experiment>/ and writes one JSON file per run.

reviewer.description: Checks each builder round against the paper and lists what must change.

evaluator.description: Computes every claim from the raw run files with its own code in repo/eval/.

audit.description: Recomputes one claim independently from the raw run files.

tuner.description: Tunes settings in repo/tuned/ towards the paper's numbers, reporting every change.

judge.description: Sets the final verdict per claim next to the rule verdicts, explaining every departure.

reporter.description: Writes report.md from the verdict table, caps and run files.
